the development of an ontology-based multi-layer robot knowledge framework (O- MRKF) that enables a robot to acquire and organize knowledge from levels of primitive behaviors to levels symbolic and contextual information.
how to implement robot intelligence by integrating robot knowledge from levels and classes in a multi-layered framework.

OMRKF is able to implement robot intelligence in a way that a robot could be able to integrate robot knowledge regardless of class of robot knowledge and to reason robot knowledge with partial and uncertain robot knowledge in a way of uni-directional or bi-directional reasoning.
